_comment: WCTA Cyber tool library data. Edit THIS FILE to add/remove tools or categories - no code changes needed. Each tool needs: category, name, url, description. Categories repeat freely; the page groups them automatically, assigns each a colour, and builds the filter buttons, boot-log mount lines, headings, counts and search index from whatever it finds here. Category display order follows the order tools first appear below. NOTE: JSON does not allow a trailing comma after the last item in the tools array - the last entry must end with } and no comma.

tools.name: OSI Model Explorer
tools.description: Click through all seven layers - protocols, devices, and PDUs at each one.

tools.name: Ports & Protocols Explorer
tools.description: Look up well-known ports and the protocols that ride on them.
